title: Sneaker splash
prompt_en: 16:9 slow-motion shot. A white running sneaker lands on a shallow puddle, water splashing outward in a crown shape. Low camera at ground level, backlit by sunset, droplets glowing. Clean urban pavement.
prompt_zh: 16:9 慢动作。一只白色跑鞋落在浅水洼上，水花呈皇冠状向外溅开。机位贴地，日落逆光，水滴发光。干净的城市路面。
why_it_works: A single impact moment with backlight emphasizes texture; ground-level angle makes the product feel heroic.
